newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher amid mixed sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher amid mixed sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka stocks, led by food and pharmaceuticals, closed higher despite a selling pressure by retail investors seeking to cash in gains, brokers said.
"The market was generally mixed. Investors booked profit on some select blue chips, but there was also support from institutional investors," said a broker.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 0.87 percent or 18.47 points at 2,135.42 on a tunrover of 262.64 million taka. Of the 107 issues traded, 57 lost, 46 gained and two unchanged. Apex Food rose 1,137 taka to 12,910.53, Megna Cement lost 25.79 to 1,096.69 and Monno Fabrics up 2.29 to 172.70.
